EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

THIS EMPLOYEE AGREEMENT (the "Agreement") made as of the ----- day of ----------------, 2024, by and between Aspada Marketing Pvt Ltd (hereinafter referred to as the "Company"), whose principal place of business is located at C- 3A/23A, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058 and --------------------, a resident of ------------------------------------------ and having PAN ------------------ and Aadhar No. -------------------------------- (hereinafter referred to as the "Employee").

WHEREAS, the Company wishes to procure the services of the Employee under the terms and conditions set forth, and the Employee wishes to be employed on these terms and conditions.

WHEREAS, the parties to this Employee Agreement wish to enter into a written expression of their relationship as Employer and Employee.

THEREFORE, in consideration of the agreements contained in this Employee Agreement, the parties, intending to be legally bound, agree as follows:

ARTICLE I: Employment
1.1 Employment: The Company agrees to employ Employee, and Employee accepts employment with the Company, on and subject to the terms and conditions set forth in this Employee Agreement.

1.2 Term: The employment of the Employee shall commence on the Effective Date as of the ------ day of -----------------------------, 2024, and shall continue until terminated by either party in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement. 


ARTICLE II: Duties
2.1 Position and Duties: The Company agrees to employ Employee to act as its employed personnel having a designation as “------------------------". Employee shall be responsible for performing the duties as described in the Induction program. Employee agrees to serve the Company faithfully and to the best of his ability during the term of employment, under the direction of the Company's Board of Directors. The Company and Employee may jointly change the nature of Employee's duties and job title from time to time.

2.2 Time Devoted to Work: The Employee acknowledges and agrees that during the term of this Agreement, the Employee shall devote all of his business time, attention, and energies solely to the business of the Company. The Employee shall not engage in any other employment, business, consulting, or professional activities, whether for compensation or not, without the prior written consent of the Company. The Employee shall not provide services to, work for, or otherwise be engaged by any third party, including but not limited to competitors, clients, or individuals or entities with which the Company has a business relationship, during the term of this Agreement.

2.3 Prior Written Consent: Any request for engaging in outside employment or activities must be submitted to the Company in writing, and the Company's consent, if granted, shall be subject to the Company's discretion. The Company's consent to any such activities shall not relieve the Employee of his obligations under this Agreement.

ARTICLE III: Place of Employment
3.1 Place of Employment: Employee shall perform his duties under this Employee Agreement at C-3A/23A, Janakpuri, Delhi 110058, India, as well as any other office of the Company located in Delhi NCR.

3.2 Reimbursement for Business Expenses: Subject to the approval of the Company, the Company shall promptly pay or reimburse Employee for all reasonable business expenses incurred by Employee in performing Employee's duties and obligations under this Employee Agreement, but only if Employee properly accounts for expenses in accordance with the Company's policies.

ARTICLE IV: Termination of Employment
4.1 Termination of Employment. Employee's employment hereunder may be terminated under the following circumstances:

4.1.1 Voluntary Termination: Employee may terminate his employment by providing an advance written notice of 60 days to the Company. During the notice period, Employee shall fulfil his job responsibilities and assist in the transition of his duties.

4.1.2 Termination by the Company for Cause: The Company may terminate Employee's employment immediately for cause. "Cause" shall mean any of the following but not limited to:
a)	Employee's material breach of this Agreement.
b)	Employee's willful misconduct, gross negligence, or refusal to perform duties assigned in a satisfactory manner.
c)	Employee's engaging in illegal activities or conduct that harms the Company's reputation or business interests.
d)	Employee's breach of the Company's policies, including those related to confidentiality and data protection.

4.1.3 Termination without Cause: The Company may terminate Employee's employment without cause upon providing written notice, effective on a date specified in the notice. In such cases, the Company agrees to provide 30 days’ notice or pay in lieu of notice as severance, subject to Employee's continued compliance with the terms of this Agreement during the notice period.

4.1.4 Termination Due to Disability: In the event Employee becomes unable to perform the essential functions of his job due to a disability for a continuous period of 30 days, the Company may terminate his employment, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

4.1.5 Termination Due to Death: Employee's employment shall automatically terminate upon his death.

4.2 Payment Obligations on Termination: In the event of termination for any reason, the Company shall promptly pay Employee any accrued salary through the date of termination, and the Employee shall be entitled to receive reimbursement for business expenses incurred prior to the termination date, in accordance with Company policies.

4.3 Return of Company Property: Upon termination of employment, Employee shall return all Company property, including but not limited to, laptops, equipment, documents, and other materials in his possession.

4.4 Survival of Certain Provisions: The provisions of Article V (Protective Covenants) shall survive the termination of this Agreement.







ARTICLE V: Confidential Information
5.1 Disclosures While Employed by the Company: Employee acknowledges that, in performing duties on behalf of the Company prior to this Employee Agreement, and in performing the duties required by this Employee Agreement, Employee has made use of, acquired, and added to, and will be making use of, acquiring and adding to the confidential and proprietary information of the Company and/or its Affiliates.

5.2 Confidentiality Obligations: Employee agrees that during the term of this Agreement and thereafter:
a)	Employee shall not use, disclose, or reproduce the Company's Confidential Information for any purpose other than in the ordinary course of employment.
b)	Employee shall take reasonable measures to protect the confidentiality and security of the Confidential Information.
c)	Employee shall promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information upon termination of employment.

5.3 Permitted Disclosures: Employee's obligations under this Article shall not apply to information that becomes publicly available without breach of this Agreement, information independently developed by Employee without reference to the Company's Confidential Information, or information disclosed pursuant to a legal obligation or court order.

5.4 Remedies for Breach: Employee acknowledges that a breach of this Article may cause irreparable harm to the Company. In the event of a breach, the Company shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief and damages which may include punitive damages.


ARTICLE VI: Protective Covenants
6.1 Non-competition: Employee acknowledges that by reason of the character and nature of the Company's and/or the Affiliates' business activities and operations, it is necessary for Employee to agree not to engage in certain specified activities in the Territory (as defined below) for a period of 12 months following termination. Therefore, during the term of this Agreement and the specified period, Employee shall not:
a)	Engage, directly or indirectly, in a business that competes with the Company's business activities within the Territory.
b)	Provide services to, work for, or otherwise assist a Competing Business (as defined below) in a capacity that is similar to or substantially similar to the services the Employee provided to the Company.

6.2 Non-solicitation of Customers: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of 24 months following termination, Employee shall not:
a)	Directly or indirectly solicit, contact, or provide services to any customer of the Company for purposes of offering products or services in competition with those offered by the Company.
b)	Use or disclose confidential customer information for any purpose other than in the ordinary course of business for the Company.

6.3 Non-solicitation of Employees and Independent Contractors: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of 24 months following termination, Employee shall not:
a)	Directly or indirectly solicit, induce, or encourage any current employee or independent contractor of the Company to leave their employment or engagement with the Company.
b)	Hire, engage, or otherwise involve any former employee or independent contractor of the Company unless they have been separated from the Company for a period of at least 12 months.
c)	Restrain from interfering with, disturbing, or attempting to disturb the relationship between the Company, its subsidiaries, or third parties, including any customer or supplier of the Company or its subsidiaries.

6.4 Reasonable Scope: If any provision of this Article is found to be overly broad or unenforceable, it shall be modified or interpreted to achieve the intended purpose to the extent necessary to make it valid and enforceable.

6.5 Definitions: For the purposes of this Article:
"Territory" shall mean the city of Delhi and the area of the National Capital Region.
"Competing Business" shall mean any person, entity, or organization engaged in retail marketing within the Territory.

6.6 Notice of New Employment: In the event, Employee engages in new employment or enters a business venture following termination, Employee shall provide written notice to the Company, including the name of the new employer or business and a description of Employee's position and responsibilities.

ARTICLE VII: Waivers
The waiver by either party of a breach of any provision of this Employee Agreement shall not operate or be construed as a waiver of any subsequent breach.




ARTICLE VIII: Entire Agreement
8.1 No Other Agreements: This instrument contains the entire agreement of the parties pertaining to the employment of the Employee by the Company. The parties have not made any agreements or representations, oral or otherwise, express or implied, pertaining to the employment of Employee by the Company other than those specifically included in this Employee Agreement.

8.2 Prior Agreements: This Employee Agreement supersedes any prior employee agreements pertaining to or connected with or arising in any manner out of the employment of Employee by the Company. All such agreements are terminated and are of no force or effect whatsoever.

8.3 Applicability of Company Policies: The employment of Employee shall be governed by this Agreement as well as the written policies of the Company, which shall be shared with the Employee. In case of any conflict between the terms of this Agreement and the Company's policies, the terms of this Agreement shall prevail.

ARTICLE IX: Amendment of Agreement
No change or modification of this Employee Agreement shall be valid unless it is in writing and signed by the party against whom the change or modification is sought to be enforced. No change or modification by the Company shall be effective unless it is approved by the Company's Board of Directors and signed by an officer specifically authorized to sign such documents.

ARTICLE X: Acknowledgment
Employee acknowledges that he has had the benefit of independent professional counsel with respect to this Agreement and that the Employee is not relying upon the Company, the Company's attorneys, or any person on behalf of or retained by the Company for any advice or counsel with respect to this Agreement.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Employee Agreement in duplicate on the date and year first above written.



Aspada Marketing Pvt Ltd                ----------------
By: [Authorized Signatory]                Employee
Date: _______________________  Date: ______________
